saints.name: St. John Paul II
saints.title: Pope
saints.shortBlurb: The Polish pope of “Be not afraid,” whose long and missionary pontificate reshaped the modern Church…
biography: Karol Wojtyła was born at Wadowice in Poland in 1920 and came of age under the Nazi occupation, working in a quarry and studying for the priesthood in secret. As Archbishop of Kraków he took a leading part in the Second Vatican Council, and in 1978 he was elected the first non-Italian pope in more than four centuries.

For nearly twenty-seven years he governed the Church, traveling to well over a hundred countries, calling the young to holiness, defending human dignity, and contributing to the peaceful fall of communism in his homeland. He suffered the last years of his life in public frailty and died in 2005; the day kept in his honour marks the inauguration of his pontificate.
saints.knownFor: His long, missionary pontificate and defense of human dignity.
